acceptedInterpretation: Implement a read-only milestone status report command over the existing ProofStory milestone ledger/checklist/evidence facts. The story does not implement an automatic executor, phase advancement, reviewer launcher, or separate milestone completion writer in V1.
notes: This interpretation follows proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md: milestone ledgers are countable intent-coverage contracts. Active milestone sub-objective detail is projected from checklist refs, verification intents, requiredEvidence hints, and future writer artifacts when present; it is not a new storage authority.
